description: Search KOSPI-listed Korean companies and corporate public procurement suppliers across precomputed, cross-linked official Korean government datasets (FSS OpenDART and Public Procurement Service KONEPS). Use this first when you have a company name (Korean or English, e.g. "Samsung Electronics", "삼성전자", "한화시스템"), a 6-digit KRX stock_code, an 8-digit DART corp_code, or a 10-digit business_registration_no. Returns up to 20 ranked candidates with kind ("listed" or "supplier"), corp_code, stock_code, business_registration_no, Korean legal name, DART/KONEPS registered English name, alternate names, and 12-month KONEPS procurement total in KRW; results sort by exact identifier match first, then listed companies, then 12-month procurement amount descending. Pass corp_code or stock_code to kr_company_profile for financials and DART filings, pass corp_code, stock_code, or business_registration_no to kr_company_procurement for KONEPS contract breakdowns, or pass business_registration_no to kr_business_status for live tax registration status. Coverage: all KOSPI companies (~830) and all corporate KONEPS suppliers (~110,000 over 12 months); corporate entities only (sole proprietors are excluded). Read-only, keyless.

query.description: Company name (Korean, English, or alternate), 6-digit KRX stock_code, 8-digit DART corp_code, or 10-digit business_registration_no

name: kr_company_search
title: Search Korean listed companies and public procurement suppliers
